design: BOSS: Lord of the Frontier, an imposing armored medieval warlord preserving his dark crowned-helmet identity. Full weathered blackened steel plate with antique bronze ornament, closed faceplate with narrow amber eye slits, a jagged iron crown built into the helmet, heavy dark fur mantle, broad tattered crimson cape and red tabard, heavy gauntlets and boots. Holds ONE SHORT broad chipped greatsword in BOTH hands in all16poses, compact enough to stay inside cell. No shield or scenery. Stylized painted/cel-shaded fantasy boss matching player knight art, regal and hostile rather than photorealistic horror. Idle planted guard and cape breathing/eye flicker; hurt staggers and braces retaining sword; attack lifts sword then executes powerful slash toward RIGHT; dodge bends knees and leans backward with sword close, recovery. Same crown/fur/armor/weapon throughout, generous clear margins.
prompt: Re-layout this exact 4x4 crowned-warlord sheet with much more transparent padding. Uniformly make every figure 25% SMALLER in its own cell and center it, while preserving serious mature knight proportions, all16poses, crown/fur/armor/red cape and sword. Reconstruct the COMPLETE sword blades of rightmost cells that currently touch the outer edge. Especially the extended sword in ROW THREE COLUMN THREE must end well BEFORE column four, with a wide gap from the next cape. Same sword visibly held in both hands in every pose. All crowns, boots, capes and weapons fully visible, no neighbor contact, same identity/material style and real transparency, no text.
